insights.headline: Fed rate-hike bets keep gold subdued while UBS sees silver at $80 by September 2027
insights.summary: MCX gold slipped for the week as hawkish Fed signals, a stronger dollar and a 19-year high in US 10-year yields weighed on bullion, with analysts warning of more choppy trade into US jobs and inflation data. UBS strategist Dominic Schnider forecast silver reaching $80 an ounce by September 2027, citing investment demand, industrial use and constrained supply. In India, the rupee steadied on dollar sales by public-sector banks while forex reserves fell $14.9 billion, and the festive season will test PM Modi's call to curb gold buying.
points: MCX October gold fell ~Rs 3,500/10g on the week to Rs 1,50,891 as Fed rate-hike bets and a 19-year-high 10-year yield weighed.
UBS's Dominic Schnider expects silver at $70 by Dec 2026 and $80 by Sep 2027, calling it a 'higher-beta version of gold'.
Rupee gained 15 paise to 95.81 as large PSU banks sold dollars; RBI forex reserves fell $14.9 billion in the week.
Gold-loan boom set to cool as personal loans take over, UBS says; NSE empanelled Augmont to promote Electronic Gold Receipts.
SGB interest stays taxable for AY 2026-27 while RBI redemption by individuals remains exempt; tighter rules apply from April 2026.

trending.title: Rate-hike bets keep a lid on gold
trending.summary: Rising Treasury yields and a firm dollar have gold set for a weekly loss; analysts expect choppy trade into US jobs and inflation data, with Main Street bullish and Wall Street split.

trending.title: Silver steps into the spotlight
trending.summary: UBS forecasts silver at $80/oz by September 2027 on gold's coattails plus industrial demand from data centres, AI and EVs; this week's sharper silver selloff shows its higher-beta character.

trending.title: India's forex cushion thins as rupee steadies
trending.summary: Forex reserves fell $14.9 billion in a week while the rupee recovered on dollar sales by public-sector banks; gold's import bill stays in focus as the festive season nears.

trending.title: Festive season to test the 'skip gold' call
trending.summary: PM Modi's appeal to curb gold buying faces its first big test as Dhanteras and Diwali approach, with jewellers and buyers weighing cultural demand against restraint.

items.title: Gold price outlook: MCX gold slips for the week as US Fed rate hike bets rise
items.summary: MCX October gold fell about Rs 3,500 per 10 grams on the week to Rs 1,50,891, erasing September's gains as hawkish Fed signals and a 19-year high in the US 10-year yield weighed on bullion, Mint reported. Fed Governor Michael Barr said further rate hikes 'are likely to be needed' to return inflation to 2%.

items.title: UBS Forecasts Silver at $80 by September 2027 as Gold and Industrial Demand Provide Support
items.summary: UBS strategist Dominic Schnider expects silver to reach $70 an ounce by December 2026 and $80 by September 2027, versus about $66.50 on September 18. Schnider called silver a 'higher-beta version of gold' with their correlation near multi-year highs, supported by investment demand, industrial use and constrained mine supply — while a hawkish Fed is the near-term risk.

items.title: Gold Loan Boom Set To Cool As Personal Loans Take Over, UBS Says
items.summary: UBS says the gold-loan boom is set to cool as personal loans take over: personal-loan growth hit a two-year high of 30% at NBFCs in August, and stabilising gold prices threaten to end the rally that lifted gold loans from 1% to 5% of GDP since FY19.

items.title: PM Modi Asked Indians To Skip Gold. Festivals Will Put That To The Test
items.summary: NDTV reports that Prime Minister Narendra Modi's appeal to Indians to cut back on gold purchases is about to meet its real test as the festive season builds toward Dhanteras and Diwali. The appeal, first made in May and renewed since, aims to curb the import bill and protect forex reserves amid the oil-price shock; jewellers and buyers now weigh cultural buying against the call for restraint.

items.title: Rupee recovers as large public sector banks sell US dollars
items.summary: The rupee gained 15 paise to close at 95.81 against the US dollar on Friday as large public sector banks sold dollars, seen acting at the RBI's behest in thin volumes, recovering from a near-96 low. Traders said the RBI was active before the open and used dollar-rupee sell-buy swaps; RBI deputy governor Poonam Gupta called the rupee 'overcorrected'.

items.title: India's forex fall by $14.9 billion in a week, says RBI: Where do reserves stand now?
items.summary: RBI data showed forex reserves dropped $14.88 billion to $765.90 billion in the week ended September 18, the sharpest weekly fall since November 2024, driven by a $14.82 billion slide in foreign currency assets. IDFC First Bank's Gaura Sen Gupta said there was an actual dollar sale of $10.9 billion with the rest revaluation loss; RBI's gold reserves rose $68 million to $111.29 billion.

items.title: Sovereign Gold Bond Tax Rules for ITR AY 2026–27
items.summary: Juris Hour lays out SGB tax treatment for AY 2026-27: interest is taxable as income from other sources; RBI redemption — including eligible premature redemption — by an individual is exempt under Section 47(viic); selling on a stock exchange is a taxable transfer. A narrower exemption for bonds not bought directly from the RBI applies only from April 2026.

items.title: Iran insists on diplomatic solution after Trump rejects peace plan
items.summary: Donald Trump on Saturday rejected Iran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days, an offer conveyed through Qatari mediators at the UN General Assembly. On Sunday, Iran's foreign minister Abbas Araqchi said only a negotiated solution could end the conflict, while the Wall Street Journal reported Trump privately expects to resume bombing Iran after the November midterms.

items.title: Gold slides 2% to $4,288, silver falls 3.7% to $63.90 on hawkish Fed, stronger dollar and rising yields
items.summary: Spot gold fell more than 2% for the week to about $4,288 an ounce and silver dropped 3.7% to $63.90 as hawkish Federal Reserve signals, a stronger US dollar and rising Treasury yields pressured bullion. On MCX, October gold closed at Rs 1,51,135 per 10 grams while December silver ended at Rs 2,33,850 per kg, with the weaker rupee cushioning the domestic decline.

items.title: Wall Street split on gold's path after drop below $4,300; Main Street stays bullish
items.summary: The Kitco News weekly gold survey showed Wall Street evenly split - 36% bullish, 29% bearish, 36% neutral - after spot gold broke below $4,300 and set a weekly low of $4,244.63. Main Street kept its bullish majority, with 57% of 152 retail voters expecting gains as a heavy US jobs-data week looms.

items.title: Gold price prediction: Experts predict Gold rate for last three months of 2026, first half of 2027
items.summary: ICICI Bank expects gold at USD 4,200-4,600/oz for the rest of 2026 and USD 4,600-5,000 in H1 2027, after a near-8% September correction on hawkish US policy repricing. LKP Securities' Jateen Trivedi said gold held the Rs 1.5-1.54 lakh/10g range and ended the week over 2% lower; the US jobs report is the next test.

items.title: Gold Faces a 5.2% Treasury Yield Wall as Fed Hike Odds Climb
items.summary: Gold faces a wall at the 5.2% US 10-year Treasury yield as markets price rising odds of another Federal Reserve rate hike, Investing.com reports. Higher real yields and a firm dollar keep pressuring the non-yielding metal, with support near $4,235 the level to watch for buyers returning.

items.title: Bullion may stay volatile as US data, W Asia tensions take focus: Analysts
items.summary: Gold and silver face another choppy week as traders turn to the US data calendar - consumer confidence, GDP and PCE inflation readings, manufacturing PMIs, Fed speeches and the non-farm payrolls report, analysts told PTI. The US-Iran standoff stays in play after Trump rejected Tehran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, with crude prices adding to the uncertainty.

items.title: Augmont Enterprises empanelled by NSE to promote Electronic Gold Receipts
items.summary: The National Stock Exchange has empanelled Augmont Enterprises to promote Electronic Gold Receipts, the exchange-traded instrument backed by physical gold held in vaults. The move aims to deepen participation in paper gold as Indian investors shift from physical holdings to regulated electronic formats.

items.title: Baanganga Gold & Diamond Files Draft Papers for Rs 720-crore IPO
items.summary: Baanganga Gold & Diamond (I) Ltd has filed a draft red herring prospectus with SEBI for an IPO of up to Rs 720 crore, comprising a Rs 540 crore fresh issue and a Rs 180 crore offer for sale by promoters. The integrated gold and diamond jewellery manufacturer plans to use Rs 405 crore of the proceeds for working capital requirements across FY27 to FY29.
